lines.en: Six thin legs row through the air.
I fly above the swamp.
My wings make a piercing whine.

lines.zh: 红树的枝子都被我绕过。
lines.en: I slip past the mangrove branches.
The damp weighs on my wings.
I skim low over the water.

lines.zh: 哪里有热气，我就往哪飞。
lines.en: Where the heat is, that's where I fly.
My proboscis stays extended.
I sweep past a clump of reeds.
The smell of mud is thick.
I drop my altitude a little.
I've settled on the leaf's underside.
My abdomen is red.
I've folded my proboscis in.
The swamp is full of water sounds.
I'm waiting for body heat.
I hold still and listen.
The mangrove roots stand in water.
There's a little mud on my wings.
I wipe my front legs.
Mist settles on my back.
I'm not like the other insects.
This place suits me well.
I hover, beating my wings slowly.
I'm judging the distance.
The muddy water never stops sounding.
I press myself a little lower.
I count the insects flying past.
My legs groom themselves slowly.
I've already slipped behind you.
You give off a lot of heat.
I've settled just above your shoulder.
You can't see where I am.
My proboscis is fine and sharp.
Only air lies between us.
Your skin is warm.
I angle myself slowly.
You shouldn't be standing here.
I'm watching the veins in your skin.
The sound in your veins is loud.
A small hole is torn in my wing membrane.
I turned a somersault and steadied.
I've retreated into the reeds.
That one hurt a great deal.
I can't fly steadily just now.
You'll have to hit me again.

lines.zh: 翅膀被打歪，我还是绕着你转。
lines.en: A wing knocked crooked, I still circle you.

lines.zh: 这点痛，换来一口血就值了。
lines.en: That bit of pain is worth one mouthful of blood.
There's no blood in that.
I want something warm.
Is this thing moving?
You're holding it very close.
I circled twice before flying off.
It has no warmth at all.
That won't distract me.
You've lifted it higher.
I'm still watching your hand.
You swatted and hit me.
I'm back again quickly.
My wing is a little crumpled.
Your fingers blocked me once.
I'm pressed against your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你挥手带起的风把我推歪。
lines.en: The wind from your swipe knocks me off course.
I dodged away at once.
Your palm raised a gust of wind.
I've landed back on your shoulder.
We're both hunting for warm blood.
You close from that side; I'll take this.
Circling together makes it easier.

lines.zh: 我们的嗡嗡声很不一样。
lines.en: Our buzzing sounds quite different.
You fly faster than I do.
This swamp is enough for us both.
We stay close without touching.
We'll move when they come.
You take the group on the left.
Let's keep watch over this water.
This thing isn't blood.
I can't lift it at all.
I push it aside a little.
It sank down into the water.
I tasted it and spat it out.
It tastes of iron.
Who left this here?
I rested on it a while.
It blocked my landing spot.
I've found the back of your neck.
Your heat is very obvious.
I'm coming closer on the left.
You can't hear my sound.

lines.zh: 你已经在这里站很久了。
lines.en: You've been standing here a long time.

lines.zh: 我选了没有衣服的地方。
lines.en: I've picked a spot with no cloth.
Swat and I'll dodge.
I only want a small sip.
I begin my slow descent.
I keep whining by your ear.
You can't swat me.
One step from you, one from me.
Your sleeve has rolled up.

lines.zh: 那里正好露着一块皮肤。
lines.en: A patch of skin shows right there.
I've settled on your neck.
The more you move the better.
Your blood beats beneath the skin.
My proboscis pierces through.
You feel a sharp sting.
Your swat caught only air.
Blood has run into my mouth.
A small patch of your skin went red.
I've come down for another try.
I didn't get in very deep.
You shook me off at once.
I rise out of the reeds.
The swamp water gives off a dull sheen.
The mangrove roots tangle together.
I haven't found my first meal yet.
The damp fogs my wings at once.
The air is all rotted mud.
I settle at the edge of a floating log.
The sun hasn't fully set.
Something is moving in the distance.
I start flying that way.
My wings beat very fast.
Fire curled my wings.
I was struck down below mid-air.
The water closed over me.
The blast flung me far.
A needle went through my wing.
That light left me dizzy.
It's been too long since I fed.
The flash blinded me for a moment.
No water below, and no wind.
